role_evidence.quote: Patients receive retifanlimab IV, over 30 minutes on day 1 of cycle 1 and DFMO PO Q8H on days 1-14 of cycle 1 in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

coder_notes: Mixed high-grade glioma population (IDH-wildtype GBM, IDH-mutant grade 3/4 astrocytoma, grade 3 oligodendroglioma, others). Both retifanlimab and DFMO are investigational and given together in all arms after surgery; Group B1 gets retifanlimab alone pre-surgically and serves as the comparator for the DFMO effect ('versus with retifanlimab alone'), so control_arm_from_other_arms yes. Registered arm intervention lists are inconsistent with arm descriptions (Group A lists no Eflornithine, Group B1 lists no Retifanlimab); agent arms follow the arm descriptions. IDH row: IDH status defines the eligible histologies (both IDH-wildtype GBM and IDH-mutant tumours allowed), so it is not a selection on one IDH state; coded eligibility as it appears in entry criteria but adjudicator may prefer to drop it. Pharmacodynamic immune markers coded as 'other'. Window-of-opportunity design with pre/post tissue.
